preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: s consists of exactly n lowercase characters of Latin alphabet
preconditions.description: String s consists of lowercase Latin alphabet characters only.

postconditions.description: The output is a string t that is a permutation of the characters in s.

postconditions.expression: t has the maximum possible value of palindromic count
postconditions.description: The output string t has the highest number of palindromic substrings among all possible permutations of the characters in s.
